olivia: quick deploy check — pushing 2026.03.20-release to canary in change window. Pin set to `v2026.03.20-canary`. Rollback criteria: latency > 250ms or errors > 1%. Backout runbook: https://rwd.in/runbooks/backout-sentinel. Deploybot will post status. @miguel you're on rollback? @sasha please monitor infra :eyes:

deploy-bot: started canary rollout for service=serving-runtime image=registry/redwood:2026.03.20-canary. canary ids: [c-12]. expected duration ~5m.

miguel: ack. watching traces + tailing logs. if we see a spike i'll trigger pin/unwind.

sasha: monitoring infra. set an alert on p95 latency at 200ms so we get an early warning.

ben: perf harness running against canary now (60s blast). will post snapshot.

deploy-bot: canary metrics: errors=0.3% (ok), p95=210ms (under rollback threshold but above watch). marking canary stable for 10m. fallback command: `rwdctl deploy backout --pin v2026.03.19-stable`.

olivia: good. keep watch for 10m. if any SLA breach escalate in-thread and follow runbook step 3 (hotpin) to immediately switch. release notes: https://rwd.in/releases/2026-03-20

tia: quick Q — does backout require DB migration rollback? this release includes a non-destructive schema tweak.

miguel: no DB rollback required, migrations are additive. runbook step 5 covers DB checks but no revert needed.

ben: load stabilized, p95 trending down to 190ms. :thumbsup:

olivia: ok closing this thread for now, will re-open if anything. :party_parrot:
